attack_queries.condition: one signer can move treasury funds alone
attack_queries.mitigation: strict-majority threshold signing and no single-key treasury

attack_queries.condition: Tau Net wallet software signs or displays a different transaction than the signer intended
attack_queries.mitigation: transaction simulation, canonical transaction previews, live wallet cap, and staged funding

attack_queries.condition: an attacker tricks signers into approving a malicious treasury transfer
attack_queries.mitigation: timelock, dual-control review, signer runbooks, and out-of-band transaction hash verification

attack_queries.condition: a governance vote attempts to drain or redirect the treasury before review
attack_queries.mitigation: timelock, spending caps, emergency freeze, and staged disbursement

attack_queries.condition: a hot wallet holding treasury funds is compromised
attack_queries.mitigation: max live treasury wallet cap and no full treasury live funding

attack_queries.condition: a signer coalition reaches threshold and signs an unauthorized transfer
attack_queries.mitigation: independent signers, public audit log, timelock, emergency freeze, and signer rotation

attack_queries.condition: Tau Net does not yet have mature threshold custody tooling for production treasury operations
attack_queries.mitigation: treat Tau Net threshold custody as unproven and keep full treasury live funding disabled
